create_SonarSpeechEncoderConfig: create a SonarSpeechEncoderConfig dataclass instance with wav2vec2 encoder and transformer decoder settings
build_english_config: build an english SonarSpeechEncoderConfig with 3 decoder layers and 1024 model dimension
build_non_english_config: build a non_english SonarSpeechEncoderConfig with 6 decoder layers and 1024 model dimension
register_sonar_speech_encoder_configs: register sonar speech encoder configs for english and non_english architectures
get_config_sonar_speech: get a sonar speech encoder config by architecture name from the dependency resolver
